snippet.title: Aaero2: Black Razor Edition | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Experience an exhilarating on-rails rhythm shooter where you trace ribbons of light, releasing the energy in the music while speeding through stunning alien environments and aiming to perfect your highest score! 

Aaero2: Black Razor Edition is preparing for take off on December 16th for PlayStation 5, GOG and EGS! The Lania Kea Music Pack and  Arcade Paradise Music Pack are launching on December 16th for Steam and Xbox. 

Wishlist on PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10014832
